_meta.scenario: Driver voluntarily cancelled the assigned trip — e.g., driver refused the trip after assignment. This is Cabbo-side fault; a full refund is triggered for the customer.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = true → full refund triggered. Distinguish from driver_unavailable: 'driver_cancelled' implies driver choice, not an operational emergency.

reason: Driver declined to complete the trip after assignment. Trip cancelled.

cancelation_detail.reason: Driver refused to proceed after accepting the trip. Customer informed and full refund initiated.
